When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows घसॢ is optionally the substitute of अद्।

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) is optionally replaced by the affix कानच्।

Terms: छन्दस्

The words एश् and इरेच् are the substitutes of ट and झ respectively in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: ल-टित्

The तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) are also called आर्द्धधातुक ।

Terms: आर्द्धधातुक

When the tense-affixes of the Perfect follow, there is reduplication of the root, which is not already reduplicated.

Terms: लिट् लकार
There takes place a vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the reduplicate (अभ्यास) of both वाच्यादि

words, when affixes of लिट् follow.

Terms: लिट् लकार

, the य in the Perfect is not vocalised.

Terms: सम्प्रसारणम्
